Data Scientist (NLP | GenAI | Computer Vision)SUSHEEL R NResults driven Data Scientist with 5+ years of expertise in NLP, Generative AI, andComputer Vision. Proven track record of building and deploying AI solutions thatenhance efficiency, automation, and decision-making. Skilled in designing scalableML/DL/GenAI models that solve real-world challenges with greater business impact.Lead Prediction System: Led development of an automated pipeline to identifypotential leads from user-configured websites using Python, web scraping, andLLMs. Integrated Airflow for weekly alerts, reducing manual monitoring andaccelerating lead discovery.Risk Prediction for Tenders: Built a risk detection model using existing libraries,Advanced RAG, and LLM agents to analyze historical tender data, improving earlyrisk identification and enabling faster, data-driven decisions.RFQ Automation Platform: Architected an end-to-end system to automateprocurement identification and RFQ generation, extracting and summarizingprocurement information across all pages using LLM- and agent-based pipelines.Integrated a chatbot interface to answer user queries on tender projects, reducingprocessing effort and turnaround time.LLM-Powered Search Engine: Developed an intelligent chatbot for 15,000+unstructured documents, designed for senior decision-makers to efficientlyretrieve information from past tenders. Leveraged Databricks, custom sectiondetection, and intelligent chunking to improve search accuracy and relevance.AI Auto-Completion System: Built a GPT-powered feature that recommendsresponses dynamically as users type, improving accuracy, speeding up drafting,and assisting users in generating or modifying answers directly in the answer box.RAG-Based Response Assistant: Implemented GPT-powered features for first-draft generation, summarization, proofreading, and readability enhancementusing RAG pipelines, enabling users to draft or modify responses in real time,resulting in faster and higher-quality RFQ response creation.Enhanced Recommendation Engine: Upgraded the recommendation pipeline byintegrating Ada embeddings with larger embedding dimensions than BERT,achieving 60% improvement in accuracy and relevance for RFP suggestions.Document Summarization: Developed a hybrid summarization pipelinecombining BERT-based extractive techniques with GPT models to generateconcise, high-quality summaries that capture critical content efficiently.Document Analysis & Requirement Detection: Built an NLP-driven system usingopen-source libraries to extract key information (dates, sections, locations,organizations, job titles, laws, monetary values, names, percentages, contactdetails, URLs, domain-specific keywords) and fine-tuned BERT/T5 for sentenceclassification to automate question/statement identification, achieving 85%efficiency improvement.Answer Snippet Extraction: Designed a SQuAD fine-tuned BERT model to retrievethe most contextually relevant portions of answers from large unstructureddocuments, eliminating manual navigation and speeding up information retrieval.Important Keyword Extraction: Implemented an algorithm leveraging SpaCy,NLTK, TextRank, RAKE, YAKE, KeyBERT to extract meaningful, domain-specifickeywords, enhancing search functionality and retrieval accuracy.Recommendation Engine: Designed an ML-powered retrieval pipeline using BERTvector embeddings and similarity search to suggest the most relevant questionsfrom a database, increasing efficiency in responding to RFPs.

EDUCATIONB.E ECE - BIT Sathy, India.2016 - 2020Person Footfall Prediction in Retail Stores: Developed a custom person re-identification module with OSNet integrated with YOLO/RT-DETR person detectionto reduce identity switches and improve tracking continuity. Used the system tomeasure footfall, identify high-traffic areas, and predict customer productinterest, enhancing retail layout, marketing strategies, and customer analytics.Vehicle Detection & License Plate Tracking: Developed vehicle detectionpipelines using YOLOv8.
